risks_before_graph.issue: Source is internally inconsistent: headline n>=2 and trailing n>=3. Preserve both. A mathematically valid n=2 extension can be ASTIS-attributed without claiming raw literal unambiguous n>=2.

HFT1.21 requires closure continuity/open harmonicity; mean-value1.4 requires a neighborhood of the closed integration ball. A pole on the outer unit sphere prevents applying closed-unit-ball mean-value directly.
Probability/support/finiteness, positivity, L1, regularity and power conversion are internal dependencies; none can become public premises.

A1 leaves simple harmonicity/continuity and norm/rpow/division steps implicit; HFT1.18 leaves Laplacian computation to reader and1.17 leaves dominated differentiation justification implicit. These must have explicit nodes/gaps or atomic external boundaries.
Poisson kernel is harmonic in its interior spatial argument for a fixed unit pole; it is not justified as harmonic in the boundary variable without an explicit swap/dilation identity.
